queries:
SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conserved_sites
FROM scanconservation sc
JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.insurstat
SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat
SELECT COALESCE(insurstat, 'Unknown') AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS site_count FROM sites GROUP BY COALESCE(insurstat, 'Unknown');
SELECT sc.*
FROM scanconservation sc
INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry;
SELECT COALESCE(s.presstat, 'Missing') AS presstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM scanconservation sc
LEFT JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY COALESCE(s.presstat, 'Missing');
